messages:
Jamie: Quick heads-up — prepping release notes + internal announce for micro-release next Thu. Need to lock pins, canary slices, and deploybot cadence today.
Alex: timeline? are we staging tomorrow or same-day canary?
Jamie: staging -> canary -> blast. Staging deploy Wed 18:00 UTC, canary Thu 09:00 UTC (small slices), blast Thu 10:30 UTC.
Maya: pinging infra for GPU pool pin. let's pin runtime image to rwinf-runtime:2026-03-01 to avoid drift.
Sam: noted. infra confirmed runtime image is available in eu-west and us-west. will reserve capacity for canary at 08:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging at 2026-03-11T18:00:00Z. Canary rollout configured: slices = [0.5%, 2%, 10%], pause = 10m between slices. Rollback hook active.
Alex: can we tighten rollback criteria? last time a noisy quantization regressed quality silently.
Maya: propose explicit criteria: - quality regression (eval set) delta >= 3% BLEU-like or eval-loss up; - production error rate > 1.5% for 5m; - p95 latency > 2s for 10m; - model hallucination spike (customer tickets > 3 in 30m).
Jamie: +1. Also add automatic fallback to previous pinned model (v1.4.2) on rollback.
Sam: locking model pin to v1.5.0-rc2 for this rollout. will annotate in release notes.
Alex: release note snippet for internal: ```
Release: micro/2026-03-11
Models: rwinf-bert-v1.5.0-rc2 (pinned), fallback: v1.4.2
Runtime: rwinf-runtime:2026-03-01
Canary slices: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% with 10m verification pauses
Rollback criteria: quality regression >=3% | error rate>1.5% | p95>2s
```
Maya: include short troubleshooting checklist in the internal announce: how to trigger rollback, where logs live, contact points.
Jamie: draft playbook bullets: - If rollback needed: comment `/rollback release micro/2026-03-11` in #eng-releases and notify ops-oncall. - Logs: staging -> CloudWatch link; prod -> prod-loki link. - Contact: ops-oncall, Sam, Maya, Alex.
Alex: suggest adding a canary-eval job that runs the eval set after each slice and posts results to the thread (automated). avoids manual eyeballs initially.
deploy-bot: Canary-eval job scheduled to run after each slice. Results will be posted to thread. Eval threshold = pass if delta < 2%.
Maya: great. also note quantization profile: Q4_0 for eu-west and Q4_1 for us-west due to hardware diffs. will add to RN.
Jamie: internal blurb draft: "Deploying micro-release to improve inference kernel selection. Expected customer impact: none. Staging Wed 18:00 UTC; Canary Thu 09:00 UTC (0.5%->10%). Rollback automated to v1.4.2 on thresholds. Ops playbook -> <link>"
Sam: LGTM. i'll pin deploybot schedule and set standby rota: Sam, Alex, Maya, ops-oncall. standby 08:00-12:00 UTC on Thu.
Alex: will prepare RN internal slack snippet and one-line for staff digest. keeping it short.
Maya: one more ask — ensure model quantization profile used is documented.
Jamie: final checklist: - [x] runtime pin - [x] model pin - [x] deploybot schedule - [x] rollback criteria documented - [x] canary eval job enabled - [ ] release note posted to #eng-releases by Alex - [ ] staff digest copy by Jamie
ops-oncall: I'll be on standby Thu 08:00-12:00 UTC. If we see >1% error rate or p95 spikes, I'll trigger rollback and call out to the team.
Jamie: thanks. Alex, paste final RN here once done?
Alex: posted internal RN in thread. cc: @everyone in eng-releases for visibility. :thumbsup: 
Deploy-bot: staging deploy complete: micro/2026-03-11 -> SUCCESS at 2026-03-11T18:02:12Z
Jamie: nice. closing sync — will open staff digest draft tomorrow morning.
